candidate_policy.ranking: maximise weakest-emotion best candidate Wilson lower bound; then eligible count
candidate_policy.qualification: NOT a validated quality threshold or emotion probability

limitations: Metadata only; audio not downloaded or auditioned
Intensity values are conditional rater judgments, not TTS controls
Wilson intervals assume independent binomial votes; shared raters and selection limit interpretation
Audio-only perception ratings do not prove transfer to novel speech
No actor/voice imitation commercial clearance asserted
